# everflow_affiliate_postback (Resource)

Manages a global server-to-server postback URL on an [Everflow affiliate](https://developers.everflow.io/docs/network/postbacks/) via the Network Pixels API.

A global postback fires on **all** offer conversions for the affiliate. `delivery_method` is hardcoded to `postback` and `pixel_level` to `global`; offer-level postbacks are not yet supported.

### Soft-delete semantics

Everflow has no DELETE endpoint for pixels. `terraform destroy` instead PUTs `pixel_status = "inactive"` and removes the resource from Terraform state. The record persists in Everflow as an inactive pixel.

### Unmodeled fields

Updates are performed as fetch-modify-put to preserve any server-side fields the schema does not expose.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set a global postback URL that fires on all offer conversions
# for this affiliate.
resource "everflow_affiliate_postback" "global_conversion" {
  network_affiliate_id = everflow_affiliate.lpb.network_affiliate_id
  postback_url         = "https://lpb.example.com/postback?tid={transaction_id}&aid={affiliate_id}"
  pixel_type           = "conversion"
  pixel_status         = "active"
  description          = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_affiliate_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the affiliate this postback belongs to.
- `pixel_status` (String) Postback status. One of `active`, `inactive`. `terraform destroy` sets this to `inactive`.
- `pixel_type` (String) Type of event that triggers the postback. One of `conversion`, `post_conversion`, `cpc`.
- `postback_url` (String) The URL Everflow fires on each conversion. Supports macros like `{transaction_id}`, `{affiliate_id}`, `{sub1}`, etc.

### Optional

- `delay_ms` (Number) Delay in milliseconds before firing the postback (0–300000). Defaults to 0 server-side.
- `description` (String) Human-readable label for this postback.

### Read-Only

- `network_id` (Number) Identifier of the Everflow network this pixel belongs to.
- `network_pixel_id` (Number) Server-assigned numeric identifier for the pixel/postback.
- `time_created` (Number) Unix timestamp (seconds) the pixel was created.
- `time_saved` (Number) Unix timestamp (seconds) of the pixel's last save.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the numeric network_pixel_id.
terraform import everflow_affiliate_postback.example 3
```
